description: This file defines a controller class for handling OAuth client-related views in the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract Vue controller, sets up a Vue component with specific props related to OAuth clients, notably including a list of unselectable client IDs.

classes.name: OAuthClientController
classes.description: A controller for managing OAuth client views, extending the AbstractVueController to leverage Vue.js components for front-end rendering.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with OAuth client data before rendering the view.
